scenes.prompt: Cinematic wide interior shot of a pakka rural farmhouse dining room in the Rajsamand plains on a dim rainy morning. Natural diffused grey daylight filters through two tall rectangular windows streaked with rainwater. On the unpolished grey-veined local marble tile floor, a long solid sheesham wood dining table has been stripped down to a single lonely place setting. Mara Vale, dressed in a somber charcoal saree with an odhna framing her hairline, sits rigid at the head of the table, staring somberly ahead beside a ribbed stainless steel glass of cold milk-tea. At the opposite end of the table rests a framed portrait of her late husband Adrian draped with a dried marigold garland. Dev Holt, an elderly caretaker in an off-white dhoti and faded potiya headwrap, stands reverently beside her, gently placing a leaning tower of unopened creditor notices on the tabletop without blocking the portrait. Visible through the wet window panes in the soft-focus farmyard outside, Viktor Dane steps out of a mud-streaked delivery truck holding a thick brown envelope. Moody, quiet, melancholic atmosphere.

scenes.prompt: Medium eye-level shot on the sheltered outdoor masonry veranda (dhalyo) of the farmhouse under pouring late-morning rain. Rain sheets off the corrugated tin roof edge onto the mud-splattered yard. Dev Holt stands firmly planted across the threshold on the rough-cut Kota stone doorstep, hands clasped loosely in front of his abdomen, barring entry with quiet, dignified authority. Outside under the narrow overhang, Viktor Dane stands with rain-dampened utility jacket, pressing a dry brown manila envelope against his chest; on the veranda step beside him, his heavy wet boots have been respectfully removed and set aside, leaving him in grey stockinged feet. Just inside the shadowed doorway, behind Dev's shoulder, Mara Vale emerges into the frame with an unyielding, severe gaze, her dark odhna drawn to her browline. Tense, confrontational threshold standoff.

scenes.prompt: Cinematic medium-close shot over the long wooden dining table inside the dim farmhouse at midday. On the table, an open vintage sheesham wood presentation case rests open, revealing a dusty, unloaded antique single-shot target pistol lying inert on faded velvet. Beside it lie a traditional red cloth bahi-khata ledger with excised pages and commercial transport invoices. In the center of the frame, Mara Vale and Viktor Dane are frozen in electrifying proximity: Mara's right hand and Viktor's hand are pinned firmly down onto the handwritten delivery log paper, their fingers making accidental contact as both freeze and lock eyes in sudden mutual shock. In the background near the kitchen door, Dev Holt stands arrested in motion holding an aluminium tea kettle and metal tray with trembling tea cups. Dramatic moody side-lighting from rainy windows, heavy psychological tension.

scenes.prompt: Atmospheric medium shot inside the small, cluttered farm office during a power cut in early afternoon. A single bright battery-powered LED camping lantern sits in the middle of a worn wooden desk, casting upward shadows and warm illumination across the characters' faces. Steel almirahs stacked with green register files and tubewell maintenance logs line the pale mint walls. Young accountant Ina Reed, in an olive rain commuter jacket over a blue kurti with spectacles, leans over an open laptop screen and handheld calculator, pointing with a pen at a spreadsheet row. Mara Vale sits back in an office chair, her shoulders dropped as her fierce defensive armor dissolves into stunned realization upon discovering the unrecorded account withdrawal. Viktor Dane leans forward on his elbows from an opposite wooden chair, staring at the screen with newfound respect. Dev Holt watches quietly from the corner. Intimate, focused forensic accounting atmosphere.

scenes.prompt: Cinematic wide exterior shot outside the open corrugated iron machinery shed in late afternoon. The downpour has ceased; rain drips steadily from the metal eaves into glistening puddles on the dark loam soil, while a pale gold strip of clearing post-storm sky illuminates the distant wheat fields and granite knolls. On the flat metal bonnet of Viktor's mud-streaked delivery truck, the signed white payment agreement paper rests alongside a brown folder. Mara Vale stands beside the truck with a subtle, composed smile, handing the small brass cabinet key into Dev Holt's open palm. Dev stands holding an aluminium tea tray with small cutting-chai glass tumblers, looking quietly pleased. Viktor Dane stands near the driver's door holding a steaming glass of dark tea, looking back toward the open farmhouse door with begrudging warmth. Ina Reed takes a photo of the contract with her smartphone in the background. Clean, crisp, transitional atmosphere.
